messages.text: isomorphisms/ai-ci PR #130, “Reject synthetic PR checkout in workflow integrity,” is open, cleanly mergeable, and all eight current-head workflows pass. It adds a reusable check that primary PR checkouts use the explicit PR-head ref while keeping dependency checkouts separate, and narrows the shell-OR detector so GitHub expressions containing `||` are not false positives. Scrutinize the parser and fixtures for loopholes or overreach, then merge it if sound.
